summary: Trinity County, TX tower listed as gone; sources give only its name, county, coordinates and a gazetteer elevation, with nothing on build, staffing or site.

facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association index marks it Tower Gone; no removal date or site description found

evidence.supports: Index lists Zion, Mount in Trinity County at 31.17748, -94.93712, status Gone
Texas list gives mt zion at the same coordinates in Trinity County
Gazetteer entry places Mount Zion Lookout in Trinity, Texas
evidence.quote: Mount Zion Lookout is in Trinity , Texas .

evidence.supports: Gazetteer gives an elevation of 318 feet for Mount Zion Lookout
Gazetteer gives the Mount Zion Lookout latitude as 31.17741 north
Gazetteer gives the Mount Zion Lookout longitude as 94.93604 west

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. Only listings and one gazetteer entry. The story body is about 107 words, under the 120-word floor, because the sources say nothing more; it was not padded. The tnlandforms list has no TFS tag and no datasheet for this site, and its numeric column is unexplained, so it is not used. Do not confuse this with the Mount Zion Lookout entries from NHLR and FFLOS in California and Washington; those are different towers. The anyplaceamerica.com topo page returned 403 and was not used. Budget: 1 web search (websearch.py) and about 4 page reads.
